branches.text: Time no longer advances for you. It moves around you. The Anchors hold, bound to the absence you became. The world stabilizes, unaware of the cost.
Civilizations rise and fall. The crisis fades into myth, then metaphor, then omission. History edits itself clean.
Perfect stability drains urgency. Innovation slows. Conflict becomes ritual. The world survives, unchanged.
You allow small failures. Death regains weight. Empires fracture. The Anchors strain but endure.
Eternity succeeds. Nothing ends. Nothing truly begins. You remain — unnoticed, unremembered.
The world adapts to danger again. It never knows your name, but it relearns choice.
